page_title: FIO 2-2 UDI | Fiorentina v Udinese 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' It will be a substitution. Antonio Tikvic (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Hassane Kamara walks off.
90+2' Isaac Success (Udinese) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Jonathan Ikone is replaced by Antonin Barak (Fiorentina).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Ranieri trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina).
87' 2 - 2 M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) takes the penalty kick and scores!
87' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
87' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
87' Referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Fiorentina. Let’s see what happens!
86' Surely that's handball by one of the Udinese players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
85' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
84' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
79' A player from Fiorentina commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is replacing Josip Brekalo.

73' 1 - 2 Goal! A terrific long pass from Sandi Lovric picks out an unmarked Florian Thauvin (Udinese) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
68' The referee blows his whistle after Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
64' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Pietro Terracciano to dive and make a save.
63' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Udinese.
62' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) for Festy Ebosele.
58' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca will be replaced by Isaac Success (Udinese).
58' Substitution. Lazar Samardzic makes way for Florian Thauvin (Udinese).

55' 1 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Davide Faraoni showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the left post – 1:1.
54' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fiorentina.
54' Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
53' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
48' The referee signals a corner kick to Fiorentina.
48' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincenzo Italiano probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina). He is replaced by Arthur Melo.
46' The game is over for Michael Kayode (Fiorentina). Davide Faraoni comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
42' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Udinese win a corner.
38' A corner kick by Udinese is thwarted by the well prepared Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina).
38' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Pietro Terracciano to dive and make a save.
37' Udinese are awarded a mid-range free kick.
35' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
34' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
27' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

23' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Pietro Terracciano easily catches the ball.
22' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.
18' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:1.
14' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

10' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Sandi Lovric (Udinese) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 0:1. Pietro Terracciano was helpless.
9' Udinese are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
4' The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
4' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
1' The match has just started.
Fiorentina will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Luca Pairetto.
